title: Коралловый оазис
scope: One artistic overview, not a calibrated projection, exact musical chart or game screenshot. Unity and existing levels unchanged.
constraints: smooth S curves and altitude changes
open lateral jump and camera clearance
final production projections from one 3D scene
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one polished environment concept illustration for the SECOND island of the original family-friendly mobile rhythm game Radio Archipelago, for the user's approval before building anything.
Input image 1 is a PALETTE, MATERIAL AND ARCHITECTURAL IDENTITY reference for our existing Coral Oasis concept. Reimagine it for the now-established airborne gameplay, with more sculptural varied elevation and open ravines. This is a concept illustration, NOT a technical orthographic projection or a finished Unity screenshot.

Create one magnificent detailed wide landscape illustration, approximately 16:9. Show an entire large floating CORAL OASIS archipelago island from an elevated three-quarter view. Large asymmetrical terracotta and coral sandstone mesas and curved rock fins, richly layered rounded erosion and convincing massive tapered rocky undersides with cliffs and hanging roots. Several uneven elevated lobes and 2–3 nearby smaller floating rock gardens, separated by generous deep airy chasms. Apricot sand, oasis-green ground cover in restrained patches, detailed teal date palms, small wildflowers and warm brass details. Beautiful saturated turquoise shallow oasis with readable shoreline stones; a slender cascading waterfall drops from an open stone cleft into a lower pool and misty open air. Soft pale blue sky and a few rounded volumetric clouds below, warm late-afternoon sunlight, delicate shadows and natural reflected light. Premium tactile stylized 3D game concept rendering, beautifully crafted believable materials, rounded friendly shapes, very detailed yet legible, like a lovingly built fantasy environment, not a crude low-poly model, not a flat painted tabletop.

RADIO ARCHIPELAGO IDENTITY: two small charming sun-baked coral adobe radio houses placed beside the route, separated from it, with rounded dark doors, brass-rimmed speaker windows, patinated turquoise copper roofs/tanks, small aerials and coral fabric pennants. On a higher rear-west terrace a short rounded signal tower with a large elegant copper/brass ring aerial. Architecture is friendly retro radio technology, no sci-fi megastructure, no cathedral, no white castle. The tower and houses are focal points with gardens and grounded foundations, never blocking the course.

GAMEPLAY ROUTE, CRITICAL: remove the reference's entire broad continuous road and all circular race-track curbs. This world has NO continuous paved road or solid bridge carrying the player. Instead show ONE clearly readable winding airy chain of thick small ROUND mint-turquoise and occasional coral CERAMIC stepping platforms with fine warm brass rims. Around 36–45 visible indicative platforms, with a few graceful curved elongated hold platforms in exactly the same ceramic style. These are evocative route markers, not a literal scored music chart. The route begins near the front-left lower oasis garden, crosses a wide open chasm, turns gradually right alongside the turquoise water, snakes gently left between two tall rock fins through an OPEN-TOP ravine, gradually climbs behind the oasis toward the radio tower terrace, then bends broadly right past the upper radio house and descends toward a distinct flower garden reward terrace to the right. Several broad S-curves and elevation changes, no uninteresting perimeter circle, no hard 90-degree corners, no tight hairpins, no intersections or confusing competing branches. All platforms float visibly above the terrain and above open gaps, never half buried in sand or rock. Landforms must naturally leave generous unobstructed lateral space and generous airborne headroom around the route. All houses, foliage, palms, hanging ropes and waterfalls remain to the sides of this corridor. No roofs or leaves over the playable path. No long tunnels, no low arch placed over the path, no wooden bridges crossing or blocking platforms. The route can return toward its entry behind a distant mesa for a future extended loop, but do not draw a bland circle around the outside of the island.
Composition: cinematic elevated overview but sufficiently near to appreciate oasis gardens and radio architecture; island fills ~82% of frame with all rock tips and tower tips contained, small clear sky margin. Strong warm sandstone vs cool turquoise contrast. Terrain should feel substantial, irregular and large enough for a 75–90 second musical journey. The beautiful world is the star, not hundreds of tiny decorations. No characters, cats, UI, text, lettering, logos, arrows, numbers, diagram lines, panels or collages. One standalone concept image.
